{{Top|leg}}
A '''telegraph''' was a device that was capable of producing and sending simple electrical messages. They were commonly found on [[Planet/Legends|planets]] that had advanced to an industrial-level of technological advancement.<ref name="AE">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref>
